items.mainDefect: The reader thread is never joined, so the assertion on caughtExceptions can run before an in-flight request adds its exception, which can make the test pass when it should fail.

secondary.defect: The non-daemon reader thread can keep running after the test method ends.

items.mainDefect: The test never makes sure the reader actually overlaps the deletes; if the thread isn't scheduled before the flag is set, its loop never runs and caughtExceptions is trivially empty.

secondary.defect: The reader thread is not joined, so an exception thrown by an in-flight read after deletedAll is set gets added after the assertion has already run.

items.mainDefect: deletedAll is only set after the delete loop finishes, so if any removal throws, the flag is never set and the non-daemon reader thread loops forever, hanging the test; the flag should be set in a finally block.

secondary.defect: The reader thread is not joined before the assertion, so an exception it hits after the delete loop finishes can be added after the assertion runs, giving a false pass.
